proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: The closed subscheme families are the coherent module families for the structure sheaves O_Z and O_W, and the tensor product O_Z tensor f^* O_W is the structure sheaf of the fibred product Z x_Y W, so the coherent construction lemma applied to these sheaves gives exactly the claimed identity (source lines 2879-2882)
